title: Forgeline - Software Engineering Study Hub
overview: Forgeline is a fast, static study hub for software engineering. It has 24 role-based roadmaps (Backend, Full Stack, Frontend, AI Engineer, DevOps, DevSecOps, Android, Data Engineer, Cyber Security, Game Developer, SEO and more), plus guides, deep dives, interview Q&A, MCQ test prep, spaced-repetition flashcards, timed mock interviews and a skill map. It covers 46 topics in about 180 pages and 200,000+ words, with Mermaid diagrams, runnable code and real-world case studies. Everything runs in the browser. Progress is saved in localStorage, so there's no account to create and no backend to run. Roadmap topic checklists are inspired by roadmap.sh, and all explanations are original. It merges two earlier projects, SWE Forge and PrepShelf, into one content taxonomy compiled from plain Markdown.

functionalities.name: 24 Role-Based Roadmaps
description: Learning tracks for 24 roles, each split into stages that link to in-depth guides with diagrams, code snippets, real-world cases, exercises and interview angles.
A progress ring per track, a "continue where you left off" button and a deterministic 15-question checkpoint quiz per roadmap.
Roadmaps on the home page, in the sidebar and in the command palette. Topic checklists are credited to roadmap.sh in the footer.

functionalities.name: Readers for Every Kind of Page
description: Guides, six deep-dive tracks (theory, internals, best practices, real-world projects, performance, pitfalls) and interview Q&A in four levels.
Table of contents with scroll spy, syntax highlighting, copyable code blocks, heading anchors, a reading progress bar and prev/next navigation.
A topic-wise prep map that links every interview area to where it's covered.

functionalities.name: Spaced-Repetition Flashcards
description: Cards are generated automatically from interview Q&A, guide sections, prep-map definitions and topic MCQs.
A daily review queue scheduled with SM-2 intervals (Again / Hard / Good / Easy); a card counts as mastered once its interval reaches 21 days.
Pick decks by topic and card type and set a new-cards-per-day limit.

functionalities.name: Mock Interview Mode
description: Timed sessions of random questions across the topics you choose; MCQs are graded automatically and open questions are self-graded against a model answer.
Results show a per-topic breakdown, weak areas linked back to study material, missed questions with "add to flashcards", and session history.

functionalities.name: Skill Map & Progress
description: Radar chart of every topic group plus a roadmap of all topics showing pages read, cards mastered and quiz/mock scores.
A ranked "what to study next" list, read and bookmark state, quiz scores, solved practice problems and a daily streak.
Export, import or reset progress; data from the old SWE Forge app is migrated automatically on first load.

functionalities.name: Search & Keyboard UX
description: Command palette (Ctrl/⌘ K or /) with section-level full-text search across all content.

Keyboard shortcuts (? lists them), light/dark theme with no flash on load, responsive layout with a mobile drawer, skip link, ARIA-labelled navigation and dialogs, reduced-motion support and print styles.

functionalities.name: Content Pipeline
description: All content is plain Markdown plus per-topic meta.json files; adding a topic means adding a folder and one manifest entry.
A build-time Node script compiles it into static JSON (catalog, search index, flashcards and one file per page) that loads lazily, so the first load stays small.

technologies.content: Markdown compiled to static JSON at build time, react-markdown, rehype-highlight

title: Draftiq - NFC Cards & Mobile Essentials Shop
overview: Draftiq is an online shop for NFC smart cards and mobile accessories (chargers, cables, covers and audio) built for Bangladesh, in English and Bangla. Shoppers design their own NFC card with a live 3D preview and set up the tap-to-share profile it opens, find the right charger, cable and cover for their phone with a guided finder, build discounted bundles, and check out on one page with cash on delivery, bKash, Nagad or bank transfer. All shop data comes live from an Express + Postgres API, and an admin panel runs orders, products, promotions and deals. One-tap demo logins let visitors try it as a customer or an admin.

functionalities.name: NFC Card Studio
description: Three-step wizard: choose one of 24 card designs, create an account and tap profile (username, socials, live preview), then order.
Each card opens a public /u/:username profile with call, WhatsApp and save-contact (vCard) actions.
A true-3D Three.js turntable hero (drag to spin, keyboard support, lazy-loaded) with a CSS flip fallback, plus a scripted NFC demo animation.

functionalities.name: Shopping Helpers
description: Mobile Finder: pick your phone and how you charge, and get a matched charger, cable and cover with a match score.
Bundle & Save: 10% off bundles with wattage and connector compatibility checks, plus admin-defined ready-made bundles.
Compare tray, wishlist, recently viewed items, reviews, new arrivals and bestsellers, and an admin-scheduled deal of the day with a countdown.

functionalities.name: Checkout & Orders
description: One-page checkout with a free-delivery progress bar, Inside/Outside Dhaka delivery estimates, gift wrap and promo codes, including a first-order coupon.
Cash on delivery, bKash, Nagad or bank transfer (NPSB), with payment receipts uploaded to object storage through presigned URLs.
Order totals and coupons are recomputed on the server; customers get an order tracking timeline and a printable invoice.

functionalities.name: Customer Account
description: Profile with saved products, lifetime value and private per-user address and card vaults (no cross-account access).
Back-in-stock notify-me watchlist and order tracking.
Full English and Bangla translations across the shop.

functionalities.name: Admin Panel
description: Revenue and orders dashboard, products, order status updates, promo codes, deal scheduling and the newsletter list.
A Visitors tab fed by the shop's own visitor tracking.

functionalities.name: Live Demo Access
description: One-tap demo logins on the login page for a customer and an admin, seeded with products, NFC designs and reviews.

technologies.frontend: React 18, Vite, Tailwind CSS v4, Ant Design, Framer Motion, Three.js, React Router 7
technologies.storage: Neon object storage (S3 SDK, presigned uploads)

title: Ledgerly - Daily AR/AP, Expense & Savings Tracker
overview: Ledgerly tracks who owes you (accounts receivable), who you owe (accounts payable), and your daily spending, budgets and savings in one place. Record dues with partial payments and an aging report, log expenses in two taps, set budgets and savings goals, and see how much is safe to spend today plus a 30-day cash forecast. Anyone can register, and every account is fully isolated: no admins and no shared data. A one-click demo opens a sandbox account with three months of sample data.

functionalities.name: Receivables & Payables
description: Record money someone owes you or you owe them, with issue date, due date and an invoice/bill reference.
Partial payments with full payment history, one-click "settle in full", and write-off / restore.
Statuses computed automatically: open → partial → overdue → settled.
Aging report (not yet due, 1-30, 31-60, 61-90, 90+ days) with CSV export, plus optional loan tracking that moves the account balance.

functionalities.name: Contacts & Reminders
description: Every contact has a running balance and a bank-style statement; contacts can be created inline while typing.
Friendly pre-written reminders sent by WhatsApp, SMS, email or the native share sheet.

functionalities.name: Daily Money
description: Two-tap expense and income entry with category chips, "yesterday" shortcuts and suggestions from frequent notes.
The amount field does calculator math, so 12+8.5 adds up a split bill.
Multiple accounts (cash, bank, mobile wallet, card) with live balances and transfers between them.

functionalities.name: Budgets, Bills & Savings
description: Per-category monthly budgets with on track / at risk / over pacing warnings.
Recurring bills and salary auto-logged on schedule (missed dates are caught up) or confirmed by hand, with monthly and yearly cost.
Savings goals with deposits and withdrawals, the monthly amount needed, a projected finish date and an on-track badge.

functionalities.name: Insight & Reports
description: "Safe to spend today": remaining budget (or cash after upcoming bills) spread over the rest of the month.
30-day cash forecast from dues, bills and income that warns before the balance dips below zero.
Income vs expenses, category breakdown, spending calendar heatmap, spend by weekday and plain-language insights.

functionalities.name: UX & Security
description: Light and dark themes, mobile bottom nav with quick add, and forms that open as bottom sheets on phones.
Ctrl/⌘ K command palette and single-key shortcuts (N, E, I, R, P, S, T).
Switch the display currency any time from ~160 ISO currencies; dates follow the user's time zone.
Every row is scoped to its owner; bcrypt passwords, JWT sessions, Helmet and rate-limited auth, Zod-validated API.

functionalities.name: Live Demo Access
description: "Explore the demo" button on the login page signs straight into a sandbox with three months of receivables, payables, expenses and savings.
The API builds the sandbox on the first demo login and rebuilds it once it is a day old (a built-in nightly reset); it can't be deleted, have its password changed or be registered by anyone else.

technologies.frontend: React 19, Vite, Tailwind CSS v4, TanStack Query, React Router, Recharts
technologies.deployment: Vercel (static app + Express as a serverless function)

title: Haat - Multi-Vendor E-commerce Marketplace
overview: Haat (হাট, the weekly village market) is a full-stack multi-vendor marketplace built for Bangladesh with four roles: buyers shop from many local sellers in one cart, sellers run their shop from a Seller Center, delivery riders claim and deliver parcels from a phone-first app, and admins run the whole marketplace. Prices are in ৳ BDT, payments cover bKash, Nagad, card and cash on delivery (simulated), and addresses map to delivery zones. One-click demo logins cover all four roles: buyer, seller, rider and admin.

functionalities.name: Buyer Storefront
description: ⌘K instant search palette plus full search and category pages, with filters (price, brand, rating, Seller Trust Score, stock, sale) kept in the URL.
Product pages with a size × colour variant picker, live stock, verified-purchase reviews, Q&A and "often bought together".
Cart grouped by shop with a per-shop free-delivery meter, save for later and shareable cart links.
Checkout with saved addresses mapped to delivery zones, platform and shop coupons, Haat Coins redemption and four payment methods.
Per-parcel order tracking, cancellations, 7-day returns, printable invoices, wishlist and price-drop / back-in-stock alerts.

functionalities.name: Seller Center
description: Sales chart (7/30/90 days), earnings after commission, order pipeline and low-stock alerts.
Product editor with multi-photo upload to Cloudflare R2, drag-to-reorder and an option matrix that auto-builds variants.
One-click Accept / Pack / Ready for pickup, printable packing slips and return approvals.
Per-SKU stock ledger and CSV bulk updates with a preview diff before applying.
Shop coupons, joining admin flash-sale campaigns, Team Buy setup, and payout history.

functionalities.name: Delivery Rider App
description: Phone-first app with an online/offline toggle, today's deliveries, earnings and cash in hand.
Open pool of packed parcels in the rider's zone, claimed atomically so two riders can't grab the same parcel.
Delivery screen with call buttons, Google Maps, handover-code keypad, camera photo proof and cash-collected confirmation.

functionalities.name: Admin Console
description: GMV, orders, AOV, commission and cash-held-by-riders dashboard.
Work queues for approving shops, products and riders; manual rider assignment and failed-delivery handling.
Per-shop commission, COD cash settlement, seller payouts, flash sales, coupons and home banners.
Category tree, brands, delivery zones, platform settings and a full activity log.

functionalities.name: Honest Discount & Team Buy
description: A "was" price is only shown when the buyer pays less than the lowest list price of the last 30 days (the EU Omnibus rule), backed by a full price history.
Group buying: start a team at the group price, share the link, and everyone pays less when the team fills; a background job refunds teams that expire.

functionalities.name: Trust, Loyalty & Secure Delivery
description: Seller Trust Score (0-100) built from 90 days of dispatch speed, ratings, cancellations, returns and Q&A responsiveness.
Haat Coins loyalty with a full ledger: earn on delivered orders and photo reviews, spend up to 20% of an order.
Every parcel gets a 4-digit handover code only the buyer sees; cash on delivery is reconciled per parcel and per rider.

functionalities.name: Live Demo Access
description: One-click demo accounts on the login page for all four roles (Buyer, Seller, Rider, Admin), seeded with shops, products, orders and payouts.

technologies.frontend: React 19, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui, TanStack Query, Recharts
technologies.authentication: JWT in httpOnly cookie, role guards (Admin, Seller, Buyer, Rider)

title: QuickFood - Food Delivery App
overview: QuickFood is a food delivery platform where customers discover local kitchens, plan meals around a budget, check out with transparent pricing and follow their order live on a real map, with the rider moving in real time over Ably. Delivery riders accept pickups and share live GPS from their own app, and restaurant partners run a five-stage kitchen board with prep times, manage their menus and read analytics, all backed by a Django REST API with a single server-side pricing engine. One-click demo logins let visitors try it as a customer, restaurant owner or rider.

functionalities.name: Discovery
description: Search across restaurants and dishes, with mood shortcuts, cuisine and dietary filters, open now, free delivery, rating and ETA filters.
Filters live in the URL so results can be shared; sort by recommended, rating, fastest, fee or popularity.

functionalities.name: Budget Bites Meal Planner
description: Set a total budget and party size and get complete meals (mains, sides, drinks, dessert) from every open kitchen, fees included.
Also works per restaurant ("Feed me for...") with diet and spice preferences.

functionalities.name: Transparent Checkout
description: Every price is a live quote from one server-side pricing engine that also prices the real order.
Saved addresses, ASAP or scheduled delivery, Priority / Standard / eco Wait & Save delivery, rider tips, promo codes and loyalty points.

functionalities.name: Real-time Order Tracking
description: Full lifecycle: placed, accepted, preparing, ready for pickup, out for delivery, delivered (or cancelled with a reason), each step timestamped on a timeline.
Live OpenStreetMap map: the rider marker moves in real time over Ably (browser GPS or a demo route), with distance and a live ETA; token auth keeps the Ably key on the server.

Status changes are pushed instantly with in-app toasts and optional browser notifications, with polling as a fallback. ETA shows a time window while cooking and exact minutes once the rider has the food.
Chat with the kitchen, self-cancel while pending, split-the-bill calculator, verified reviews and one-tap reorder.

functionalities.name: Restaurant Partner Tools
description: Overview with revenue, average order, rating, repeat customers, cancellation rate, busiest hour and top dishes.

Five-stage kitchen board (New, Accepted, Cooking, Ready, On the way): accept with a prep time that drives the customer's ETA, prep countdown on every ticket, reject with reason until pickup, new-order chime, live rider location sharing and pause/resume per restaurant.
Menu management with categories, dietary flags, spice level, calories, photo upload and an instant sold-out toggle.

functionalities.name: Delivery Rider App
description: Rider role with its own sign-up and profile: photo, phone, vehicle and number plate, online/offline availability, rating, deliveries and earnings including tips.
Rider dashboard with available and assigned orders: accept a pickup (first come, first served), mark it picked up and delivered. New pickups arrive instantly over Ably.
Live location from the rider's browser GPS over Ably drives the customer's map. Customers see the rider's card, can call them, and rate them after delivery.

functionalities.name: Accounts & Rewards
description: JWT authentication with automatic token refresh for customers and restaurant owners.
Loyalty points on every order with Bronze to Platinum tiers, favourites, saved addresses, dark mode and reduced-motion support.

functionalities.name: Live Demo Access
description: "Explore the demo" card on the login page: one click signs in as a customer, a restaurant owner or a delivery rider. The demo board is topped up automatically with orders in every stage, so tracking and the kitchen board always have something live to show.
The seed command always restores the public demo password, and the API blocks demo users from changing username, email, password or role.

technologies.frontend: Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, SWR
technologies.realtime: Ably (token auth, status pushes, live rider location), Leaflet + OpenStreetMap

title: NexTechCare - Technology Support Marketplace
overview: NexTechCare is a technology support marketplace covering software, hardware, IT consultancy, data recovery, networking, cybersecurity, cloud and backup, device setup, smart home and remote support. Customers describe a problem in plain words and get an instant AI triage, then book a verified engineer and follow the job on a live tracker with an SLA countdown. Engineers are ranked by a transparent Trust Score. Version 2 is a full rebuild: a Next.js 15 frontend on Netlify and a Django REST API moved from Render to Vercel, on Neon Postgres. A one-click demo lets visitors sign in as a customer, engineer or admin with realistic data that resets every night.

functionalities.name: AI Issue Triage
description: Customers describe a problem in plain words and Groq (gpt-oss-120b) returns the category, urgency, a short summary, safe first steps and up to three matching services from the live catalog.
AI output is validated against the catalog and allowed categories. If the key is missing, the call fails or rate limits hit, a keyword rule engine answers instead, so triage never breaks.
Triage notes carry into the booking, so the engineer starts with context.

functionalities.name: Live SLA Tracker
description: Every booking moves Requested, Accepted, In progress, Resolved (or Cancelled) with role-checked transitions.
Each service sets its own SLA hours. Bookings show a countdown and turn red when breached, and the timeline records every step with engineer notes. Pages refresh automatically.

functionalities.name: Engineer Trust Score
description: A 0-100 score built from customer ratings (45%), completion rate (25%), response speed (20%) and admin verification (10%), with a neutral starting point for new engineers.
It is shown on every service card and drives catalog sorting, the admin leaderboard and the workload view.

functionalities.name: Role Dashboards
description: Customer: open requests, pending reviews and quick triage.
Engineer: job queue, service create/edit/delete with category and SLA, and a Trust Score breakdown.
Admin: KPIs (open bookings, SLA breaches, average resolution, rating), a 14-day trend, demand by category, bulk approve/reject, engineer verification, the contact inbox and an activity feed.

functionalities.name: Platform & Deployment
description: The API URL is set by environment (NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL): localhost for development, the Vercel API on Netlify.

Django settings are env-driven. The API runs on Vercel's Python runtime against Neon Postgres (pooled connections at runtime, direct for migrations), with additive migrations so the old deployment kept working during the cut-over.
JWT auth, three roles, dark and light themes, mobile-first layouts and accessible forms.

functionalities.name: Live Demo Mode
description: One-click demo logins for customer, engineer and admin, issued by a backend endpoint, so no passwords live in the browser.
Server-side guards keep demo users from editing profiles or deleting data; the demo admin only sees and manages demo users, services and bookings.
A seed command builds realistic data across all ten categories and every tracker state, and a Vercel Cron job resets it nightly.

technologies.frontend: Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, lucide-react
technologies.backend: Django 4.2, Django REST Framework 3.15, Groq API

title: InterEd Hub
overview: InterEd Hub is a video-first online course platform. Students stream lessons, pin notes to the exact second, keep a daily learning streak and earn verifiable certificates. Teachers build courses in a studio with drag-and-drop curriculum and upload videos straight to Neon Object Storage, while a Django REST API handles catalog, progress, discussion and analytics. One-click demo logins let visitors explore as a Teacher or a Student.

functionalities.name: Course Catalog
description: Search with subject, level, length and rating filters, all synced to the URL so results can be shared.
Course pages with free-preview lessons, curriculum, outcomes, instructor card and rating breakdown.

functionalities.name: Learning Player
description: Resume where you left off, remembered playback speed, keyboard shortcuts and an auto-advance countdown.
Timestamped notes (press N while watching, click a note to jump back) and per-lesson discussion with highlighted instructor replies.
Watch-time heartbeats mark lessons complete at 90% and keep course progress in sync.

functionalities.name: Streaks & Certificates
description: Student dashboard with daily learning streaks, weekly minutes, a 12-week activity heatmap and continue-learning.
Printable, shareable certificates with a public verification code.

functionalities.name: Teacher Studio
description: Build courses from sections and video or reading lessons, with drag-and-drop reordering and preview toggles; publishing needs at least one lesson.
Direct-to-storage uploads with progress, speed and ETA; files over 64 MB upload in parallel chunks with retries, and dropping several videos creates a lesson for each.

functionalities.name: Teacher Analytics
description: Learners, average rating, minutes watched, a 30-day enrollment chart, an unanswered-questions inbox and per-course completion rates.

functionalities.name: Video Storage & Streaming
description: Videos, covers and avatars live in a private Neon Object Storage bucket; the browser uploads with presigned URLs, so bytes never pass through Django.
Playback uses short-lived presigned URLs with HTTP range requests for instant seeking; expired URLs are re-signed automatically.

functionalities.name: Live Demo Access
description: "Explore the demo" card on the login page: one click signs in as a Teacher (Studio and analytics) or a Student (enrolled courses and reviews).
Demo accounts come from an idempotent seed command, and the API returns 403 if a demo user tries to change their username, email or password.

technologies.storage: Neon Object Storage (S3 API, presigned and multipart uploads)

title: HealthOps Connect
overview: HealthOps Connect is a complete hospital operations platform: patients describe symptoms in plain words and get matched to the right specialist with transparent reasoning, book real time slots (in-person or video), check in from their phone with a live token and a wait estimate learned from actual consultation times, and keep a health passport with vitals trends and QR-verifiable e-prescriptions. Doctors get a triage-ordered queue with one-click call-next plus a consultation workspace with drug-allergy checks, while operations staff run a live command center with front desk, bed board and a privacy-safe waiting-room TV display. One-click demo logins let visitors explore as a patient, doctor or staff member.

functionalities.name: Care Finder & Booking
description: Describe symptoms in plain words; a transparent rule engine suggests the right specialty and shows which words led there.
Red-flag phrases (chest pain, stroke signs, severe bleeding, self-harm) trigger an emergency banner instead of a booking.
Weekly schedules become real bookable slots, in-person or video; double-booking is impossible (partial unique index in Postgres, not just the view).
Digital intake (reason, symptoms, severity, duration) captured while booking with live triage hints; urgency computed automatically.

functionalities.name: Virtual Queue & Waitlist
description: Check in from your phone up to 2 hours early, get a token and a live wait estimate learned from the doctor's actual recent consultation times.
Priority follows clinical urgency, then arrival; waiting-room screen shows token numbers only, never names.
Smart waitlist: join for a fully booked day and get notified the moment someone cancels or reschedules.
Calendar (.ics) export, self reschedule/cancel, reviews after completed visits, in-app + email notifications.

functionalities.name: Health Passport & E-Prescriptions
description: Allergies, conditions, medications and emergency contact in one place; log BP, heart rate, glucose, SpO2, temperature and weight with trend charts and range alerts.
Printable e-prescriptions with a QR code pharmacies scan to confirm they are genuine (public verify page shows initials only).
Privacy log: every clinician/staff access to your record is logged and visible to you.

functionalities.name: Doctor Workspace
description: Today's schedule, live queue with one-click Call next, weekly stats and a 14-day trend.

Consultation workspace: intake, allergy banner, vitals trends and previous visits side by side; notes and prescriptions with automatic drug-allergy conflict checks (overrides are explicit and recorded).
Weekly hours editor, one-click time off, public profile editor; new doctors are listed only after operations staff verify their licence.

functionalities.name: Operations Command Center
description: Visits today, waiting, urgent cases, revenue collected/outstanding, attendance, per-doctor utilisation and queue load, ward occupancy, 14-day outcome chart.
Front desk: today's arrivals with check-in, payment, no-show and cancel actions.
Bed board: ward/bed grid with admit and discharge (discharged beds go to cleaning first).

functionalities.name: UX & Accessibility
description: Semantic HTML, keyboard focus styles, skip link, status never shown by colour alone, chart data always available as a table, dark mode and reduced-motion support.
Video visits via per-visit unguessable Jitsi rooms (or the doctor's own meeting link).

functionalities.name: Live Demo Access
description: "Explore the demo" card on the login page for Patient, Doctor and Staff, backed by an idempotent seed_demo command with realistic appointments and records.

technologies.frontend: Django templates, Tailwind CSS v4, HTMX, Alpine.js, Chart.js
technologies.database: PostgreSQL (Neon, pooled) with SQLite fallback for local dev
technologies.storage: Neon Object Storage (S3 API) via django-storages
technologies.deployment: Vercel (Django runtime, sin1), Render + Gunicorn, WhiteNoise

title: RetroBookStore - Neighbourhood Lending Library
overview: RetroBookStore is a neighbourhood lending library reimagined: pick a book by how you want to feel, take a blind date with a mystery read, join a waitlist that saves your copy, and get your year in books wrapped up in December. Version 3 is a full rebuild in Django 5.2 (MVT) on Neon Postgres, with real circulation rules, full-text search, recommendations, gamification and a warm retro design with light and dark themes. One-click demo logins let visitors explore as a Reader or a Librarian.

functionalities.name: Discovery
description: Mood-based discovery: pick how you want to feel (adventurous, cosy, tense...) plus a pace, and books are ranked by how many of your moods they hit.
Blind Date with a Book: three wrapped books shown only by spoiler-free hints, borrowed at 20% off, unwrapped with a reveal animation and rated for "chemistry" afterwards.
Recommendations: a "for you" shelf built from loans, ratings, shelf and favourite genres, plus "readers who borrowed this also borrowed" and "if you like this, try".

functionalities.name: Smart Search
description: Postgres full-text search weighted across title, author, genre and description with a GIN index.
pg_trgm typo tolerance ("hobit" finds The Hobbit), live results as you type and a ⌘K / Ctrl+K quick-search palette.

functionalities.name: Circulation
description: 14-day loans, up to 2 renewals (blocked when others are waiting), 5 books at once, per-day late fees and a 50% refund on return.
Waitlist / holds: when every copy is out, readers queue up; on return the next reader's copy is reserved for 48 hours and they are notified.
Every money and stock change runs in one database transaction with row locks; a daily cron sweep expires stale holds and sends due-soon and overdue reminders.

functionalities.name: Readers & Wallet
description: Verified reviews: only borrowers can rate a book (1-5 stars with distribution bars and spoiler blur).
Append-only wallet ledger with running balance, quick top-ups and filters.
Notifications bell and inbox for holds ready, due soon, overdue, badges and deposits, with optional emails.

functionalities.name: Gamification
description: XP and levels (Page Turner to Librarian of Legend), 10 badges, monthly borrow streaks, a yearly reading-goal ring and a community leaderboard.
Reading Wrapped: a Spotify-Wrapped-style yearly recap with books, pages, top genres and moods, favourite author, a month-by-month chart and a reader persona.

functionalities.name: Staff & UX
description: Staff dashboard with KPIs, a 30-day loan chart, overdue list, most borrowed and a "buy more copies?" list ranked by waitlist per copy.
Tailwind v4 design system, light and dark themes, Open Library cover art by ISBN with generated fallbacks, HTMX partial updates, responsive and keyboard / screen-reader friendly.

functionalities.name: Live Demo Access
description: "Explore the demo" card on the login page: one click signs in as a Reader (with loan history, reviews and badges) or a Librarian (staff dashboard).
An idempotent seed_demo command creates and refreshes both accounts on every production deploy; demo users can't change their email, and the librarian is staff but never a superuser.

technologies.frontend: Django templates, Tailwind CSS 4, HTMX 2, Alpine.js 3, Chart.js 4
technologies.database: PostgreSQL 17 (Neon) with full-text search and pg_trgm
technologies.storage: Neon Object Storage (S3 API) via django-storages

title: aSocial Media
overview: aSocial is a calm social space made for introverts. People write slowly, react gently and choose how they talk: slow pen-pal letters that take hours to arrive, or quiet real-time messages over Ably with no streaks or pressure to reply. There are no likes, public follower counts or infinite scroll. Posts carry moods, rich text, @mentions and #hashtags, each with its own audience (public, followers or only me), and an always-visible session timer, gentle reminders and an optional daily limit nudge people to log off. A role-based moderation dashboard, a report queue that tells reporters the outcome, and an audit log keep it gentle.

functionalities.name: Letters & Real-Time Messages
description: Pen-pal letters still arrive after about 15 minutes, 3 hours or 12 hours and open in a lined-paper view, with no typing bubbles or read receipts.

Messages are the live option, delivered over Ably: presence for online status, a typing indicator that fades, read receipts and optimistic sending. The API issues short-lived, subscribe-only Ably tokens (the key never reaches the browser), with a WebSocket and then polling as fallbacks. Recipients choose who may write to them.

functionalities.name: Post Privacy & Rich Text
description: Each post is Public, Followers or Only me, and the server enforces it on feeds, search, profiles, tags and single-post links.

Sanitized rich text (bold, italic, lists, links, code) with a Write/Preview toggle, @mentions with autocomplete and notifications, and #hashtag suggestions drawn from public tags, each with its own page.

functionalities.name: Gentle Reactions & Quiet Counts
description: Felt this, Sending a hug, Insightful and Relate instead of likes, on posts and on replies.
Authors see a breakdown of reaction totals that stays private unless they choose to show counts; follower counts stay private.

functionalities.name: Moods, Prompts & Content Notes
description: Tag posts with a mood, filter the feed by mood, and see a private five-week mood garden.
A soft daily prompt whose question appears on every answer and links to a page of all answers, with previous/next day navigation, plus anonymous posting and content notes that blur sensitive posts.

functionalities.name: Time Well Spent
description: Active time is tracked per session and stored as server-side daily totals; a session timer stays visible in the sidebar, with optional reminders every 10 to 90 minutes and a 7-day chart.
An optional daily limit sends one gentle nudge a day with a breathing exercise. The feed still ends with "You're all caught up", and a social battery status hushes notification badges.

functionalities.name: Moderation & Safety
description: Role-based admin dashboard (the role lives in the database and is granted by a script) with community stats, people and post management.

Report posts, replies, messages or people with a reason; moderators hide content, suspend accounts, or resolve and dismiss from a queue. Reporters get a notice with the outcome, authors hear when a post is hidden or restored, and every decision lands in an audit log.

functionalities.name: Secure Media & Accounts
description: Images are resized and re-encoded in the browser (EXIF stripped), checked by magic bytes and stored in a private Neon Object Storage bucket behind presigned URLs.
bcrypt passwords, JWT auth, keyset pagination, full-text search (Postgres tsvector + GIN), light/dark themes and a mobile layout with bottom navigation.

technologies.frontend: React 19, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, TanStack Query, React Router
technologies.realtime: Ably (token auth, presence) with WebSocket and polling fallbacks

title: Green Biotech
overview: Marketing and ordering website for Green Biotech BD, a Bangladesh-based company supplying verified veterinary medicines for poultry, cattle, aquaculture and pets. Visitors browse medicines by animal category, search the catalog, read product details, add items to a cart and place cash-on-delivery orders that reach the company by email. The site also covers the company profile, certifications, careers and contact, with server-rendered structured data for search engines.

functionalities.name: Product Catalog
description: Browse medicines by category (Poultry, Cattle, Aqua, Pets) with filters for supplier, medicine type and stock, sorting by name or price, and pagination.
Product pages with active ingredients, indications, usage, packaging, pricing and stock status.
Navbar search with live suggestions across all categories.

functionalities.name: Cart & Cash-on-Delivery Orders
description: Cart saved in the browser with quantity controls, line totals and an order total.
Checkout collects name, email, phone, delivery address and notes, then sends the order with a generated order ID and the full item list through EmailJS.

functionalities.name: Company Pages
description: About page with mission, values and animal-specific expertise.
Certificates with modal detail views, job listings with email applications, and a contact form with toast feedback.

functionalities.name: SEO & Analytics
description: Dynamic sitemap, server-rendered Organization, Product and Breadcrumb JSON-LD, Open Graph and meta tags, and a web app manifest.
First-visit intro animation remembered in the browser, plus Vercel Analytics and Speed Insights.

technologies.frontend: Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4

title: Arvix Creative
overview: Website and back office for Arvix Creative, a creative design studio. The public site presents the studio's services, packages, project portfolio, team and client reviews, and runs Arvix Academy: recorded design classes stream privately from Cloudflare R2 to enrolled students through short-lived signed URLs, in a player with resume, progress, timestamped notes and practice files. Teachers and admins manage every course in a Course Studio. The first course is Creative Samurai Volume 1 by Tanvirul Islam (32 classes). An Express + Postgres API powers moderated reviews, the contact inbox, enrollments and the academy, and an admin area records course payments and prints student ID cards.

functionalities.name: Studio Website
description: Home page with hero, services, projects, stats, packages, clients, team and reviews, plus seasonal sections for Eid, Ramadan and birthdays.
Project portfolio with a detail page per project, about, contact, tools, privacy and terms pages, with per-page SEO tags.

functionalities.name: Reviews & Contact
description: Visitors submit reviews that appear on the site only after an admin approves them.
Contact form messages are stored and read in the admin area.

functionalities.name: Arvix Academy: Recorded Classes
description: Recorded classes stream privately from a Cloudflare R2 bucket: enrolled students get short-lived (30-minute) signed URLs, re-signed automatically so playback continues from the same spot.
First course: Creative Samurai Volume 1 by Tanvirul Islam, 32 classes in weekly modules, with a recorded-classes section on the home page and a course landing page.

functionalities.name: Learning Player
description: Resumes where you left off, tracks per-class progress, counts down to the next class, and offers playback speeds and keyboard shortcuts.
Timestamped notes and bookmarks on the timeline (exportable as Markdown), and practice-file downloads per class.

functionalities.name: Course Studio
description: Teachers and admins manage every course: upload videos straight from the browser to R2 in parallel chunks, add practice files, reorder classes across weekly modules, see each video's status and preview any class.

functionalities.name: Roles & Accounts
description: Admin (everything), teacher (own courses only, can't enroll) and student (enrolled courses only).
Students activate their account themselves with their Student ID; admins can reset passwords and every user can change their own.

functionalities.name: Admin & Enrollments
description: Review moderation, contact inbox and an enrollments table.
Payment records per enrollment (course fee, discount, amount paid, fully-paid check) and printable student ID cards with sequential student IDs.

technologies.frontend: React 18, React Router 6, Tailwind CSS, daisyUI, react-helmet-async

title: Green Biotech ERP System
overview: B2B distribution ERP for Green Biotech, a veterinary-medicine distributor, built on Express + React (TypeScript, Drizzle ORM, PostgreSQL). Customers are shops grouped into territories, each owned by a salesman. The system covers sales orders, invoices, payment collection, returns and refunds, procurement and purchase orders, stock, employees and accounting with journal entries, a ledger, a trial balance and reports. It is a ground-up rebuild of the earlier Spring Boot + React version, designed around the ledger as the single source of truth and strict, tested business rules.

functionalities.name: Sales & Distribution
description: Territories, shops and salesmen, with sales orders, invoices, payment receives, returns and refunds.
Printable sales orders, invoices and purchase orders rendered to PDF on the server.

functionalities.name: Procurement & Stock
description: Purchase orders with receiving, and product management.
Every stock change is written to an append-only stock-movements table with rows locked (SELECT … FOR UPDATE), so concurrent orders can't oversell.

functionalities.name: Accounting
description: Chart of accounts, journal entries, ledger, trial balance and printable reports.
Each business event posts to the ledger exactly once through an idempotency key; reversals are contra entries, never edits.
Money is stored as numeric(14,2) and calculated with decimal.js.

functionalities.name: Workflow Rules
description: Documents move through declarative state machines; illegal transitions are rejected with 409 and the API tells the UI which actions are legal next.
Race-free document numbering.

functionalities.name: Access, Audit & Quality
description: Territory-scoped role-based access, admin and salesman dashboards, employees, activities, notifications, an audit trail and settings.
JWT access tokens with a rotating httpOnly refresh cookie and argon2 password hashing.
Zod schemas shared between API and UI; Vitest + Supertest tests cover the ledger, stock and state-machine invariants.

functionalities.name: Earlier Version
description: The first release ran on Spring Boot with Spring Security (JWT), JPA and PostgreSQL behind a React frontend, and included a RAG-based assistant chatbot.

technologies.frontend: React 19, Vite, TypeScript, shadcn/ui, Tailwind CSS v4, TanStack Query & Table, React Hook Form
technologies.authentication: JWT access token + rotating httpOnly refresh cookie, argon2

title: Al Noor Specialised Hospital
overview: Full-stack hospital website and admin panel for Al Noor Specialised Hospital in Cox's Bazar, Bangladesh, in English and Bangla. Patients browse departments, doctors and health packages and book a chamber slot online in a few steps. Hospital staff confirm and complete appointments, manage doctors and their schedules, publish notices and packages, answer messages and read first-party, cookie-free visitor analytics from a protected admin dashboard.

functionalities.name: Patient Website
description: Departments, doctors with filters, doctor profiles with fees and weekly schedules, health packages and notices.
Board (org chart), certifications, equipment, careers, contact and FAQ pages, fully translated into English and Bangla.

functionalities.name: Online Booking
description: Book a consultation in steps (department, doctor, slot, details), plus a separate service booking form.
Appointments move Pending → Confirmed → Completed with no downgrades; the confirmation email with the fee is sent only on confirmation.

functionalities.name: Admin Panel
description: Dashboard with bookings, revenue from confirmed fees and visitors today and right now.
Appointments with printable A4 registers by date range, and doctors with schedules, fees and daily slot capacity.
Packages, services, notices, board and certifications management, a service-booking inbox, a contact inbox with unread count, and site settings.
Admin login locks after 3 failed attempts.

functionalities.name: Visitor Analytics
description: First-party, cookie-free tracking of page views and time on page.
Overview KPIs against the previous period, live visitors, top pages, sources, countries and devices.
Visit log with search, filters, CSV export and per-visit journeys, with bot filtering, retention-based deletion and rate-limited tracking.

functionalities.name: SEO
description: Localized titles, JSON-LD (including job postings), sitemap, robots.txt and llms.txt.

technologies.frontend: React 19, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui, TanStack Query, react-i18next

title: Nibash - Property Rental, Sale & Serviced-Stay Platform
overview: A full-stack real estate platform for Dhaka covering rentals, buy & sell, serviced stays with online booking, and commercial space. Visitors search with shareable filters beside a price-pin map, book serviced apartments by the night, and send inquiries or call requests. Owners list their own properties through a 6-step wizard and track leads and bookings, while admins verify listings and oversee the whole platform.

functionalities.name: Smart Search & Map
description: Separate sections for Rentals, Buy & Sell, Serviced Stays and Commercial Space.
Filters for area, price, beds/baths, type, furnishing, amenities, verified only, dates and guests, all kept in the URL so results can be shared.
Desktop results sit beside a clustered price-pin map; mobile gets a map/list toggle. Serviced stays already booked for the chosen dates are excluded.

functionalities.name: Serviced-Stay Booking
description: The server quotes each stay (nights × rate + cleaning + service fee).
A booking places a 30-minute hold and checks for overlaps inside a serializable transaction, so the same dates can't be double-booked.
Payment is simulated for the demo build; guests can cancel before check-in for a refund.

functionalities.name: Lead Capture
description: Inquiry and "Book a Call" forms on buy/sell and commercial listings.
Every lead is saved so owners and the sales team can follow up and track its status.

functionalities.name: Owner Self-Listing & Dashboard
description: 6-step listing wizard: basics, details, location with map pin, photos, price & amenities, and review.
Listing lifecycle: Draft → Pending review → Published or Rejected with a reason.
Owner dashboard with live and in-review listings, new leads, bookings, earnings and saves.

functionalities.name: Admin Panel
description: Review queue to approve listings or request changes, plus Verified badges, featuring and archiving.
Manage users, all bookings and payments, and leads, with an activity log and platform overview charts.

functionalities.name: Accounts & Security
description: Email OTP verification through Resend: only an HMAC of the code is stored, with expiry, resend cooldown and lockout after wrong guesses.
JWT in an httpOnly cookie, wishlist / saved homes, and image uploads to Cloudflare R2 checked by their file signature.
Taka formatted with lakh/crore grouping (৳1,20,000, ৳6.5 cr).

technologies.frontend: React 19, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui, TanStack Query, React Hook Form, Leaflet
technologies.authentication: JWT (httpOnly cookie), email OTP via Resend

title: Arvix Resume Builder
overview: An ATS-friendly resume builder with a guided, step-by-step editor and AI writing help. People build their resume one section at a time next to a page-accurate live preview, pick from 12 ATS-safe templates, tailor it with a job match checker, then download a PDF or share a private, view-only link. No account needed: resumes stay private to the browser that created them.

functionalities.name: Guided Step-by-Step Editor
description: Nine focused steps (contact, summary, experience, education, skills, projects, certifications, design, review) with progress and per-step status.
Inline validation that appears once a field is touched, and saving jumps straight to the first step that needs attention.
Draft autosave, JSON import/export, and edit or duplicate a saved resume to tailor it for a job.

functionalities.name: Page-Accurate Live Preview
description: The preview renders at true letter width and scales to fit, so line and page breaks match the downloaded PDF.
Zoom, page-break markers and a one-click template switcher; a full-screen preview on mobile.

functionalities.name: AI Writing Assistant
description: Draft professional summaries, rewrite any bullet as an achievement, get skill suggestions and a template recommendation.
AI ATS score with concrete fixes and keywords on the review step (Groq, Llama 3.3 70B).

functionalities.name: Job Match Checker
description: Paste a job description to see keyword coverage and which terms are covered or missing.
Runs entirely in the browser, so the job text is never uploaded.

functionalities.name: ATS-Safe Output
description: 12 single-column templates with real text and standard headings, plus section reordering and hiding.
Print-optimised PDF with cleanly extractable text, a plain-text copy for application forms, and a view-only share link that search engines don't index.

functionalities.name: Private by Default
description: No accounts and no public resume listing: each browser only sees the resumes it created.
Edits and deletes need a per-resume edit token; only its hash is stored, and the API validates every resume it saves.

technologies.frontend: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4
